title: Root-cause report — Driver/Customer load failure

symptoms.driver: App does not open (module graph fails before boot)
symptoms.customer: Loads partially / UI broken / buttons non-functional (same failed module graph breaks event wiring)

rootCause.summary: Phase 2 runtime-consistency change made shared/js/phase1-billing-diagnostics.mjs import production constants via repo-relative paths (../../driver-app/... and ../../customer-app/...). Hosting build inlines that file into /partner/js and /customer/js (and /shared/js). Those relative imports resolve to hosting-dist/driver-app/... and hosting-dist/customer-app/... which do not exist on Firebase Hosting (apps are served as /partner and /customer).
rootCause.failureMode: Browser ES module load throws Failed to resolve module specifier / 404 for ../../driver-app/js/location-checkpoint-policy.mjs (and sibling imports). field-diagnostics → phase1-billing-diagnostics fails → app entry modules reject → driver never boots; customer interactive handlers never bind.
evidence: Resolved paths under hosting-dist: hosting-dist/driver-app/js/... = BROKEN (MISSING)
Resolved paths under hosting-dist: hosting-dist/customer-app/js/... = BROKEN (MISSING)
Actual hosted locations are partner/js/* and customer/js/* (or /js for root customer)
Node tests passed because filesystem monorepo paths exist; production hosting layout does not

notRootCause: Firebase / matching / bargaining / P2P transport / location policy logic changes
Need to roll back Phase 1–5 consistency work (values/aliases must stay; only import paths for hosting must be fixed)
status: STOPPED — awaiting approval for Step 2 (smallest fix)
